title: ContainmentRefusalBody
description:
Serve's HTTP 400 body for a refused contained dispatch:
`{"error": "<human prose>", "reason": "<code>"}`. A non-containment 400
carries `{"error": …}` with NO `reason` key, which this type does not model.

ContainmentRefusal.description:
Why blackwall-serve refused a dispatch that carried `containment`
(`docs/specs/est-318-containment-attestation.md` §6.1 rule 1, soma#514).
Exactly these five kebab-case tokens: serve emits them, reflex parses them,
so a typo cannot pass both suites.

A TRANSPORT refusal, separate from the four-value audit
[`crate::wire::Reason`]. Only `containment-profile-changed` maps across, and
that mapping lives in reflex, not here.
